states.guardrail: A hidden control is not authorization; stale confidential detail is cleared.

states.name: Session expired
states.presentation: Remove protected state; preserve only safe navigation context for sign-in.
states.guardrail: Credential clearing/session-generation fencing prevents stale restoration.

states.name: Busy
states.presentation: Keep the initiating action's width and replace its label with specific progress text.
states.guardrail: One write in flight; competing writes and duplicate submission disabled.

states.name: Validation
states.presentation: Error summary plus field-local message; focus the first invalid field.
states.guardrail: Existing API constraints repeated; secrets never echoed in an error.

states.name: Conflict
states.presentation: Explain that the reviewed record/phase/version changed and reload it.
states.guardrail: No silent overwrite, automatic replay, or local status correction.

states.name: Unknown outcome
states.presentation: Keep the submitted context and show that confirmation is unavailable.
states.guardrail: Reconcile first; never manufacture success or duplicate a financial/request action.

states.name: Confirmed
states.presentation: Render only the actual confirmed result appropriate to this page.
states.guardrail: A static check cannot imply payment/assignment/eligibility beyond the response.

states.presentation: Reserve the shape of unknown content; retain known title, scope and navigation.

states.name: Error
states.presentation: Inline failure explanation beside the affected content/action; preserve safe draft.
states.guardrail: Retry only the failed read or reconcile the actual write outcome.

states.name: Offline
states.presentation: Retain permitted last-confirmed context; add freshness and connection notice.
states.guardrail: Disable unsafe writes; do not book, accept, authorize or settle locally.

states.name: Stale
states.presentation: Mark last-refresh/observation age; leave confirmed lifecycle facts legible.
states.guardrail: Re-read before time-sensitive or authority-changing commands.

name: Readiness decision review
composition: Exact gate/config revision, independent-review explanation, passed/failed choice and safe evidence reference
controls: Record decision; Cancel
guardrails: F/A/P; evidence 3–240 characters; maker cannot review; owner/dates are in the referenced evidence, not invented API fields
title: Review rollout gate
intro: Record the exact passed/failed evidence decision on an approved or active configuration.

items.label: Reviewer
items.value: Authorized actor distinct from configuration submitter

items.label: Evidence reference
items.help: 3–240; non-secret runbook/ticket/test-run/analytics reference; no documents or participant identifiers

items.label: Owner/review/expiry
items.value: Carried by referenced evidence; no invented extra request field

actions.label: Record decision
actions.effect: emit the documented intent only after its current prerequisites hold

actions.label: Cancel
actions.effect: return, dismiss or navigate without changing server facts

specific: Conflict requires renewed exact-record review; no copied evidence files or locally passed gate. Maker/checker remains enforced by the backend.
